name: livestock-manager-premium
description: Sistema profesional de gestión ganadera con comercialización masiva, trazabilidad industrial, Informes Premium y Gestión por Especies v4.0.0.

scripts.build: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (-not (Test-Path www)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path www | Out-Null }; Copy-Item -Path index.html, manifest.webmanifest, sw.js -Destination www -Force; foreach ($d in 'css','js','icons','manual','tests') { Copy-Item -Path $d -Destination www -Recurse -Force } "
scripts.build:free: npm run prebuild:free && npm run build
scripts.build:premium: npm run prebuild:premium && npm run build
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:premium && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:free: set FREE_MODE=true&& npm run build:free && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:premium: set FREE_MODE=false&& npm run build:premium && npx cap sync android
